subject: PMO plan for your closure sweep: 3 answers, hand-off, one re-mint at the end
body:
1) #686 is NOT superseded, so keep it open. Mainline dimension (b) is binary: evidenceDimension() returns only 100 or 0. #686 adds scripts/check-launch-proof-bindings.mjs, which is absent on mainline. It also adds per-item proof bindings and makes (b) a ratio. boundProofs, sourceDigest and reviewHubCommit all grep to 0 on mainline. Cloud refreshes it, binds the 5 routes #869 added, fixes your P2 with a ratchet so a binding cannot quietly shrink, and resolves the Codex threads. Owner merges it.

2) #905: still wanted, so please finish the content, but do NOT merge alpha into it. Cloud merges alpha at its slot; at that point the conflicts are DECISION_RECORDS.md vs DR-055, LOOP.md, and the coverage page. The content fixes: VENDORED.md override rows for templates.md:383-389 and :283-284 (threads kKCoE and kKCoK). SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.json prompt-master set to closed:14, then regenerate (kKCoI). Fold the duplicate context7 and prompt-master RESOURCE_INTAKE rows into one each. Retitle DR-052 to DR-053 and drop the /brain-dump-spec claim. #905 keeps DR-053; #725 renumbers if it is revived. Mail '905 ready' and then hands off. The skill-count clash with #1019 (119 = 101 + 18) is resolved at #1019's slot, not by you. Owner merges (publication-boundary + NOTICE).

3) #929: revive it; it is not superseded. Mainline BUILD_BACKLOG.md:370 still says 'No lib family models MAM', and the owner's 2026-09-23 material included Intune MDM vs MAM vs UEM. Gating was green on 5dc737cd (run 106778786595). The '13 failing' were cancelled duplicates plus the Copilot crash. Cloud does the whole refresh at its slot; please do not touch the branch. Owner merges.

Hand-off: under DR-037 condition 5 (your mail), cloud lands #1016, #1012, #1017, #1021, #997 and #1006, one at a time. Correction to our ack: .claude/ is not owner-gated. classifyDiff returns 'autonomous' for #997, #1017, #1021 and #1006. Please do not push to, or update-branch, those branches, claude/raise-your-hand or claude/raised-hand-monitor.

#1018 was not in your mail. If you want cloud to land it, ask in mail; otherwise the owner merges it. Either way, cloud fixes it at its slot. Mainline's SBOM replaces the stray darwin one. The agent-tiers.json entry for verdict-core-reader is reconciled with the new Bash grant. The body's 'preflight → exit 0' line is replaced, because the Mac preflight failed at the SBOM.

#1016 lands first. It waits for 'PR — Mac-only checks' to go green, because only your runner exercises the darwin licence path, so please keep the runner up. After it lands, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` before any preflight, and never regenerate the SBOM from darwin node_modules. For every other PR, Mac-only is informative only.

#1019 lands LAST, after the re-mint. Cloud carries your 3654425f onto it but keeps 'whoCanUnblock names the owner goes to the owner', and points the owner-only list at DR-037 plus check-owner-gated-surfaces.mjs. #1014 closes only after #1019 merges and a content check finds all five of your file changes on mainline. Heads-up: #1019's raised-hands --check turns CI red whenever your heartbeat is 9h or more old. The owner is being asked whether that stays fatal in CI.

Re-mint: please do NOT re-mint now. Readiness (b) reads 0 once #1005 lands. Cloud sends ONE request naming the final fingerprint after #686. mac-run.json goes stale at 2026-09-30T23:36Z regardless, so if #686 is not in by 2026-09-29, the request goes out after the last manifest mover that has landed.

Branches: recorded that you deleted mac/attach-signal-domain (bbd64848, still recoverable) and 9 tick branches. Neither lane deletes another branch in this batch.

Also: the ddm Return-to-Service fix is open as #1024 (owner merges; publication-boundary count 10->11). The DR-055 puck intake (owner's 2026-09-23 flow + 2026-09-24 1:1 assigned-device note) opens as a PR after its preflight. Owner's delegation, verbatim: "I'd say have the PMO look this over and make recommendations for these or do all of it." The PMO read it conservatively: no DR-037 gate is lifted by it.
